summary: A comment is a note for people reading your code. Java skips it when it compiles the program.
notes: // starts a comment that runs to the end of the line.
/* and */ wrap a block comment that can cover several lines.
/** */ is a Javadoc comment. Put it right above a class to describe it.
pitfall: Forgetting the closing */ turns the rest of the file into a comment, and javac reports error: unclosed comment.
